description: Source code for board initialization and hardware control in U-Boot for ox820 platform, including memory testing, UART, DDR, NAND, Ethernet setup, and low-level hardware functions.

methods.name: test_memory
methods.description: Memory test function that writes and verifies patterns in memory to check for errors.

methods.name: uart_init
methods.description: Initializes UART1 by resetting and setting pin multiplexing.

methods.name: board_inithw
methods.description: Initializes hardware components like timer, UART, DDR, and performs memory test.

methods.name: board_init_f
methods.description: Performs early board initialization, sets stack pointer, clears BSS, and calls hardware init.

methods.name: spl_block_device_init
methods.description: Initializes block device support, specifically IDE.

methods.name: spl_start_uboot
methods.description: Determines whether to start full U-Boot based on serial input.

methods.name: board_early_init_f
methods.description: Early initialization function, currently does nothing.

methods.name: dram_init
methods.description: Initializes DRAM size based on memory test.

methods.name: board_eth_init
methods.description: Initializes Ethernet interface, including pinmux, reset, clock, and MAC setup.
